home.title: Obordeleau, air-conditioned studio at Les Sablettes, 70 m from the beach
home.description: A 3-star studio at Les Sablettes near Toulon. Beach on foot in 2 minutes, shuttle boat to Toulon at the door, no car needed. Book direct.

hero.subtitle: Park the car and forget about it. The sandy beach at Les Sablettes is a two minute walk through the park, the shuttle boat to Toulon leaves from the foot of the building, and the shops and restaurants are all in the neighbourhood.
hero.imageAlt: The Obordeleau studio and the beach at Les Sablettes, La Seyne-sur-Mer

gallery.intro: One bright 35 m² room opening onto the garden, arranged so that nothing is missing: sleeping corner, dining corner, plenty of storage, and air conditioning for the hot days.

amenities.intro: The studio is equipped for a simple holiday: you arrive with your suitcases, the rest is already here.

air-conditioning.label: Air conditioning
air-conditioning.note: A real difference on the hottest days.

private-garden-view.label: Private garden view
private-garden-view.note: Greenery outside the windows, not the street.

no-facing-neighbours.label: No facing neighbours
no-facing-neighbours.note: Nobody opposite, so you can live with the windows open.

free-parking.label: Free parking
free-parking.note: Across the street, for the days the car does not move.

travel-cot.label: Travel cot on request
travel-cot.note: Just mention it in your message.

storage.label: Plenty of storage
storage.note: Suitcases get emptied and put away.

honest.title: Worth knowing before you book
honest.intro: So that nothing surprises you on arrival, here is what we would rather say in advance.

notes.compact: This is a 35 m² studio. It is ideal for two, and it works well for a family of four thanks to the sofa bed.
notes.bed-between-walls: The main bed sits between two walls. Worth knowing if you are taller than 1.90 m.
notes.light: The room faces the garden, so the light is soft. One guest found it a little dark in the middle of the day.
notes.mosquitoes: The park next door, which everyone loves, also brings a few mosquitoes in summer.

around.intro: Everything is walkable. That is why most guests leave the car in the parking space for the whole stay.

beach.label: Les Sablettes sandy beach
beach.detail: Straight through the park, without crossing a road.

seaside-park.label: Seaside park
seaside-park.detail: Turtles, frogs and a fitness trail, a favourite with families.

boat-shuttle.label: Shuttle boat to Toulon
boat-shuttle.detail: The landing stage is at the foot of the building: Toulon, the bay and the islands.

shops.label: Shops
shops.detail: Bakery, small supermarket and pharmacy in the neighbourhood.

restaurants.label: Restaurants
restaurants.detail: Along the seafront, a few minutes on foot.

market.label: Market
market.detail: The local market, also within walking distance.

toulon.label: Toulon
toulon.detail: By boat from the landing stage, and the crossing is part of the holiday.

about.portraitAlt: Corine, who welcomes guests to the Obordeleau studio
paragraphs: I have been welcoming guests to this studio for several years, and what I care about is that they feel at home straight away.
I do my best to work around your arrival and departure times, especially when you are travelling a long way or leaving at the end of the day.
Linens and towels are provided, the studio is clean and ready when you arrive, and I stay reachable throughout your stay if you need a tip about the area.

intellectual.title: Intellectual property
intellectual.body: The texts and photographs on this site belong to the publisher. Reproduction without permission is not allowed. Guest reviews remain the property of their authors and are reproduced unaltered.

credits.title: Credits
credits.body: Mapping: Google Maps, loaded only after your agreement. Audience measurement: Vercel Web Analytics, without cookies.

principle.title: The principle
principle.body: This site collects the minimum. No personal data travels in page addresses, no advertising cookie is set, and no third party service loads before you explicitly agree.

inquiry.title: Your booking inquiry
inquiry.body: When you send the form, we email the owner the details you entered: name, email address, phone number if you give one, requested dates, number of guests and message. They are used only to reply to you. They are never sold, never used for marketing, and they stay in the owner's mailbox for the length of the exchange, then are deleted at the latest three years after the last contact. The site itself keeps no database.

analytics.title: Audience measurement
analytics.body: We use Vercel Web Analytics, which measures traffic without cookies and without an identifier that would recognise you from one visit to the next. We know how many people saw a page and which booking buttons were clicked, never who you are.

map.title: The map
map.body: The Google Maps map does not load until you click "Show the map". Until you accept, no request goes to Google. If you accept, Google receives your IP address and may set cookies under its own rules. Your choice is stored in your browser (local storage) and you can withdraw it at any time from the map section.

hosting.title: Hosting and logs
hosting.body: The site is hosted by Vercel, which keeps technical connection logs to run and secure the service. Inquiry emails are sent through Resend, a transactional email service.

reviews.title: Reviews and profile photos
reviews.body: Reviews are shown with the first name only. Profile photos are hosted on this site and are not loaded from a third party.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask for access to, correction of, or deletion of your details by writing to {email}. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority.
